comment:
* Call fail causes from TS 24.008 .
 * These are mostly the cause codes we need to distinguish for the UI.
 * See 22.001 Annex F.4 for mapping of cause codes to local tones.
 *
 * CDMA call failure reasons are derived from the possible call failure scenarios described
 * in "CDMA IS2000 - Release A (C.S0005-A v6.0)" standard.
 *
 * The detailed fail causes are defined in ITU Recommendation Q.850.
 *
 * {@hide}
 *

variables.name: NOT_VALID
variables.comment: The disconnect cause is not valid (Not received a disconnect cause)

variables.name: UNOBTAINABLE_NUMBER
variables.comment: Unassigned/Unobtainable number

variables.name: USER_ALERTING_NO_ANSWER
variables.comment:
* This cause is used when the called party has been alerted but does not respond with a connect
     * indication within a prescribed period of time. Note - This cause is not necessarily generated
     * by Q.931 procedures but may be generated by internal network timers.

variables.name: CALL_REJECTED
variables.comment:
* The equipment sending this cause does not wish to accept this call, although it could have
     * accepted the call because the equipment sending this cause is neither busy nor incompatible.
     * The network may also generate this cause, indicating that the call was cleared due to a
     * supplementary service constraint. The diagnostic field may contain additional information
     * about the supplementary service and reason for rejection.

variables.name: NON_SELECTED_USER_CLEARING
variables.comment: The user has not been awarded the incoming call.

variables.name: INVALID_NUMBER_FORMAT
variables.comment: Incomplete number

variables.name: FACILITY_REJECTED
variables.comment: Supplementary service requested by the user cannot be provide by the network.

variables.name: NETWORK_OUT_OF_ORDER
variables.comment: Resource unavailable

variables.name: REQUESTED_FACILITY_NOT_SUBSCRIBED
variables.comment:
* The user has requested a supplementary service, which is available, but the user is not
     * authorized to use.

variables.name: INCOMING_CALL_BARRED_WITHIN_CUG
variables.comment:
* Although the called party is a member of the CUG (Closed User Group) for the incoming CUG
     * call, incoming calls are not allowed to this member of the CUG.

variables.name: SERVICE_OR_OPTION_NOT_AVAILABLE
variables.comment:
* This cause is used to report a service or option not available event only when no other cause
     * between 49-62 (where a service or option is unavailable) applies.

variables.name: ACM_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
variables.comment: Service or option not implemented

variables.name: ONLY_RESTRICTED_DIGITAL_INFO_BC_AVAILABLE
variables.comment:
* The calling party has requested an unrestricted bearer service but that the equipment sending
     * this cause only supports the restricted version of the requested bearer capability.

variables.name: USER_NOT_MEMBER_OF_CUG
variables.comment: Invalid message

variables.name: MESSAGE_TYPE_NON_EXISTENT
variables.comment: Protocol error

variables.name: CONDITIONAL_IE_ERROR
variables.comment:
* The equipment sending this cause has received an information element which it has
     * implemented; however, one or more fields in the information element are coded in such a way
     * which has not been implemented by the equipment sending this cause.

variables.name: CALL_BARRED
variables.comment: Others

variables.name: DIAL_MODIFIED_TO_USSD
variables.comment: Stk Call Control

variables.name: RADIO_OFF
variables.comment: The call cannot be established because RADIO is OFF

variables.name: NO_VALID_SIM
variables.comment: The call cannot be established because of no valid SIM

variables.name: RADIO_INTERNAL_ERROR
variables.comment: The call is dropped or failed internally by modem

variables.name: NETWORK_RESP_TIMEOUT
variables.comment: Call failed because of UE timer expired while waiting for a response from network

variables.name: NETWORK_REJECT
variables.comment: Call failed because of a network reject

variables.name: RADIO_ACCESS_FAILURE
variables.comment: Call failed because of radio access failure. ex. RACH failure

variables.name: RADIO_LINK_FAILURE
variables.comment: Call failed/dropped because of a Radio Link Failure (RLF).

variables.name: RADIO_LINK_LOST
variables.comment: Call failed/dropped because of radio link lost

variables.name: RADIO_UPLINK_FAILURE
variables.comment: Call failed because of a radio uplink issue

variables.name: RADIO_SETUP_FAILURE
variables.comment: Call failed because of a RRC (Radio Resource Control) connection setup failure

variables.name: RADIO_RELEASE_NORMAL
variables.comment: Call failed/dropped because of RRC (Radio Resource Control) connection release from NW

variables.name: RADIO_RELEASE_ABNORMAL
variables.comment:
* Call failed/dropped because of RRC (Radio Resource Control) abnormally released by
     * modem/network.

variables.name: ACCESS_CLASS_BLOCKED
variables.comment: Access class blocked - TS 31.121 5.2.1

variables.name: NETWORK_DETACH
variables.comment: Call failed/dropped because of a network detach.

variables.name: EMERGENCY_TEMP_FAILURE
variables.comment: Emergency Redial

variables.name: CDMA_NOT_EMERGENCY
variables.comment: For non-emergency number dialed while in emergency callback mode.

variables.name: CDMA_ACCESS_BLOCKED
variables.comment: Access Blocked by CDMA Network.

variables.name: LOCAL_ILLEGAL_ARGUMENT
variables.comment: The passed argument is an invalid

variables.name: LOCAL_ILLEGAL_STATE
variables.comment: The operation is invoked in invalid call state

variables.name: LOCAL_INTERNAL_ERROR
variables.comment: IMS service internal error

variables.name: LOCAL_IMS_SERVICE_DOWN
variables.comment: IMS service goes down (service connection is lost)

variables.name: LOCAL_NO_PENDING_CALL
variables.comment: No pending incoming call exists

variables.name: LOCAL_POWER_OFF
variables.comment: Service unavailable; by power off

variables.name: LOCAL_LOW_BATTERY
variables.comment: Service unavailable; by low battery

variables.name: LOCAL_NETWORK_NO_SERVICE
variables.comment: Service unavailable; by out of service (data service state)

variables.name: LOCAL_NETWORK_NO_LTE_COVERAGE
variables.comment:
Service unavailable; by no LTE coverage
     * (VoLTE is not supported even though IMS is registered)

variables.name: LOCAL_NETWORK_ROAMING
variables.comment: Service unavailable; by located in roaming area

variables.name: LOCAL_NETWORK_IP_CHANGED
variables.comment: Service unavailable; by IP changed

variables.name: LOCAL_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
variables.comment: Service unavailable; other

variables.name: LOCAL_NOT_REGISTERED
variables.comment: Service unavailable; IMS connection is lost (IMS is not registered)

variables.name: LOCAL_MAX_CALL_EXCEEDED
variables.comment: Max call exceeded

variables.name: LOCAL_CALL_DECLINE
variables.comment: Call decline

variables.name: LOCAL_CALL_VCC_ON_PROGRESSING
variables.comment: SRVCC is in progress

variables.name: LOCAL_CALL_RESOURCE_RESERVATION_FAILED
variables.comment: Resource reservation is failed (QoS precondition)

variables.name: LOCAL_CALL_CS_RETRY_REQUIRED
variables.comment:
Retry CS call; VoLTE service can't be provided by the network or remote end
     *  Resolve the extra code(EXTRA_CODE_CALL_RETRY_*) if the below code is set

variables.name: LOCAL_CALL_VOLTE_RETRY_REQUIRED
variables.comment: Retry VoLTE call; VoLTE service can't be provided by the network temporarily

variables.name: LOCAL_CALL_TERMINATED
variables.comment: IMS call is already terminated (in TERMINATED state)

variables.name: LOCAL_HO_NOT_FEASIBLE
variables.comment: Handover not feasible

variables.name: TIMEOUT_1XX_WAITING
variables.comment: 1xx waiting timer is expired after sending INVITE request (MO only)

variables.name: TIMEOUT_NO_ANSWER
variables.comment:
User no answer during call setup operation (MO/MT)
     *  MO : 200 OK to INVITE request is not received,
     *  MT : No action from user after alerting the call

variables.name: TIMEOUT_NO_ANSWER_CALL_UPDATE
variables.comment:
User no answer during call update operation (MO/MT)
     *  MO : 200 OK to re-INVITE request is not received,
     *  MT : No action from user after alerting the call

variables.name: SIP_REDIRECTED
variables.comment: SIP request is redirected

variables.name: SIP_BAD_REQUEST
variables.comment: 400 : Bad Request

variables.name: SIP_FORBIDDEN
variables.comment: 403 : Forbidden

variables.name: SIP_NOT_FOUND
variables.comment: 404 : Not Found

variables.name: SIP_NOT_SUPPORTED
variables.comment:
415 : Unsupported Media Type
     *  416 : Unsupported URI Scheme
     *  420 : Bad Extension

variables.name: SIP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
variables.comment: 408 : Request Timeout

variables.name: SIP_TEMPRARILY_UNAVAILABLE
variables.comment: 480 : Temporarily Unavailable

variables.name: SIP_BAD_ADDRESS
variables.comment: 484 : Address Incomplete

variables.name: SIP_BUSY
variables.comment:
486 : Busy Here
     *  600 : Busy Everywhere

variables.name: SIP_REQUEST_CANCELLED
variables.comment: 487 : Request Terminated

variables.name: SIP_NOT_ACCEPTABLE
variables.comment:
406 : Not Acceptable
     *  488 : Not Acceptable Here
     *  606 : Not Acceptable

variables.name: SIP_NOT_REACHABLE
variables.comment:
410 : Gone
     *  604 : Does Not Exist Anywhere

variables.name: SIP_CLIENT_ERROR
variables.comment: Others

variables.name: SIP_TRANSACTION_DOES_NOT_EXIST
variables.comment: 481 : Transaction Does Not Exist

variables.name: SIP_SERVER_INTERNAL_ERROR
variables.comment:
5xx responses
     *  501 : Server Internal Error

variables.name: SIP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
variables.comment: 503 : Service Unavailable

variables.name: SIP_SERVER_TIMEOUT
variables.comment: 504 : Server Time-out

variables.name: SIP_SERVER_ERROR
variables.comment: Other

variables.name: SIP_USER_REJECTED
variables.comment:
6xx responses
     *  603 : Decline

variables.name: SIP_GLOBAL_ERROR
variables.comment: Others

variables.name: IMS_EMERGENCY_TEMP_FAILURE
variables.comment: Emergency failure

variables.name: MEDIA_INIT_FAILED
variables.comment: Media resource initialization failed

variables.name: MEDIA_NO_DATA
variables.comment: RTP timeout (no audio / video traffic in the session)

variables.name: MEDIA_NOT_ACCEPTABLE
variables.comment: Media is not supported; so dropped the call

variables.name: MEDIA_UNSPECIFIED
variables.comment: Unknown media related errors

variables.name: USER_TERMINATED
variables.comment: User triggers the call end

variables.name: USER_NOANSWER
variables.comment: No action while an incoming call is ringing

variables.name: USER_IGNORE
variables.comment: User ignores an incoming call

variables.name: USER_DECLINE
variables.comment: User declines an incoming call

variables.name: LOW_BATTERY
variables.comment: Device declines/ends a call due to low battery

variables.name: BLACKLISTED_CALL_ID
variables.comment: Device declines call due to blacklisted call ID

variables.name: USER_TERMINATED_BY_REMOTE
variables.comment: The call is terminated by the network or remote user

variables.name: UT_NOT_SUPPORTED
variables.comment: * UT

variables.name: ECBM_NOT_SUPPORTED
variables.comment: * ECBM

variables.name: MULTIENDPOINT_NOT_SUPPORTED
variables.comment: * Fail code used to indicate that Multi-endpoint is not supported by the Ims framework.

variables.name: CALL_DROP_IWLAN_TO_LTE_UNAVAILABLE
variables.comment:
* CALL DROP error code for the case when a device is ePDG capable and when the user is on an
     * active wifi call and at the edge of coverage and there is no qualified LTE network available
     * to handover the call to. We get a handover NOT_TRIGERRED message from the modem. This error
     * code is received as part of the handover message.

variables.name: ANSWERED_ELSEWHERE
variables.comment: MT call has ended due to a release from the network because the call was answered elsewhere

variables.name: CALL_PULL_OUT_OF_SYNC
variables.comment: For MultiEndpoint - Call Pull request has failed

variables.name: CALL_PULLED
variables.comment: For MultiEndpoint - Call has been pulled from primary to secondary

variables.name: SUPP_SVC_FAILED
variables.comment:
* Supplementary services (HOLD/RESUME) failure error codes.
     * Values for Supplemetary services failure - Failed, Cancelled and Re-Invite collision.

variables.name: IWLAN_DPD_FAILURE
variables.comment: DPD Procedure received no response or send failed

variables.name: EPDG_TUNNEL_ESTABLISH_FAILURE
variables.comment: Establishment of the ePDG Tunnel Failed

variables.name: EPDG_TUNNEL_REKEY_FAILURE
variables.comment: Re-keying of the ePDG Tunnel Failed; may not always result in teardown

variables.name: EPDG_TUNNEL_LOST_CONNECTION
variables.comment: Connection to the packet gateway is lost

variables.name: MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_CALLS_REACHED
variables.comment:
* The maximum number of calls allowed has been reached.  Used in a multi-endpoint scenario
     * where the number of calls across all connected devices has reached the maximum.

variables.name: REMOTE_CALL_DECLINE
variables.comment:
* Similar to {@link #CODE_LOCAL_CALL_DECLINE}, except indicates that a remote device has
     * declined the call.  Used in a multi-endpoint scenario where a remote device declined an
     * incoming call.

variables.name: DATA_LIMIT_REACHED
variables.comment: * Indicates the call was disconnected due to the user reaching their data limit.

variables.name: DATA_DISABLED
variables.comment: * Indicates the call was disconnected due to the user disabling cellular data.

variables.name: WIFI_LOST
variables.comment: * Indicates a call was disconnected due to loss of wifi signal.

variables.name: EMC_REDIAL_ON_IMS
variables.comment: * Indicates a call was disconnected because retry over volte is needed.

variables.name: EMC_REDIAL_ON_VOWIFI
variables.comment: * Indicates a call was disconnected because retry over vowifi is needed.

variables.name: OEM_CAUSE_1
variables.comment:
OEM specific error codes. To be used by OEMs when they don't want to
       reveal error code which would be replaced by ERROR_UNSPECIFIED
